name: ui-form-section
description: FormSection — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui form-section pattern).

schema.description: FormSection — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui form-section pattern).
schema.name: ui-form-section

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

cancelEvent.description: Event to dispatch on cancel (defaults to 'CANCEL')
cancelEvent.label: Cancel Event

cancelLabel.description: Cancel button label (if provided, shows cancel button)
cancelLabel.label: Cancel Label

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

fieldOverrides.description: Per-field display-copy overrides (label/placeholder/hint), merged by field name over the schema-enriched fields.
fieldOverrides.label: Field Overrides

fields.description: Fields definition (schema format) - accepts readonly for generated const arrays
fields.label: Fields

hiddenCalculations.description: Hidden calculations that emit GLOBAL_VARIABLE_SET on field change (boolean true means enabled but config loaded separately)
hiddenCalculations.label: Hidden Calculations

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

mode.description: Form mode — 'create' for new records, 'edit' for updating existing. Accepts `string` so schema-driven callers (whose `config.mode` is typed as `string` per the trait's declared config block) compile cleanly. The runtime treats anything other than 'edit' as 'create'.
mode.label: Mode

onCancel.description: Cancel event name for trait dispatch (emitted via eventBus as UI:{onCancel})
onCancel.label: On Cancel

onFieldChange.description: Callback when any field value changes
onFieldChange.label: On Field Change

onSubmit.description: Submit event name for trait dispatch (emitted via eventBus as UI:{onSubmit})
onSubmit.label: On Submit

relationsLoading.description: Loading state for relation data: { fieldName: boolean }
relationsLoading.label: Relations Loading

repeatable.description: Whether the form supports repeatable entries
repeatable.label: Repeatable

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

sections.description: Nested form sections with optional conditions
sections.label: Sections

selfFetch.description: true (default) = a mount that carries an id loads that one row (never the collection); a create-mode mount skips the load. false = a composing atom owns the load.
selfFetch.label: Fetch its own row on mount?

showCancel.description: Show cancel button (defaults to true for schema forms)
showCancel.label: Show Cancel

showSubmit.description: Show submit button (defaults to true for schema forms). Set false when a parent atom owns the submit action externally (e.g. wizard footers).
showSubmit.label: Show Submit

skeleton.description: The shape an empty slot shows while this form's server render is in flight (`none` opts out). @default 'form'
skeleton.label: Skeleton

submitEvent.description: Event dispatch props (for trait state machine integration)
submitEvent.label: Submit Event

surface.description: Content surface: `auto` paints the theme's surface (with card padding) behind this block unless it already sits on one (a card, dialog or another block); `none` opts out.
surface.label: Surface

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

title.description: Form title (used by ModalSlot to extract title)
title.label: Title

violationTriggers.description: Violation conditions that emit VIOLATION_DETECTED when met (boolean true means enabled but config loaded separately)
violationTriggers.label: Violation Triggers

emits.description: Event dispatch props (for trait state machine integration)
Event to dispatch on cancel (defaults to 'CANCEL')
Callback when any field value changes
FormSection row finished loading; payload.data holds the single row.

events.description: Mount payload; a host that routes to this panel by id (a :id page param) passes it here.
events.name: Initialize

events.description: FormSection row finished loading; payload.data holds the single row.
events.name: Form section loaded

events.description: Event dispatch props (for trait state machine integration)
events.name: @config.submit event

events.description: Event to dispatch on cancel (defaults to 'CANCEL')
events.name: @config.cancel event

events.description: Callback when any field value changes
events.name: @config.on field change
